handback.t:
I wrote eight Norwegian (bokmål) `.no.md` files in `C:\Users\mariu\ventures\customs-duty-recovery`, committed them and pushed to `origin` (`97da29d..f35d53e` on main). Nothing was run beyond the commit and push; the translations were not re-read after the final edits. The commit message ends with the Claude Opus 4.8 co-author line.

**Files created:**
- `README.no.md`
- `ARCHITECTURE.no.md`
- `business/business-plan.no.md`
- `business/market-analysis.no.md`
- `financial/model.no.md`
- `fundraising/README.no.md`
- `hiring/README.no.md`
- `marketing/seo-and-growth.no.md`

**Not created:** the repo has no `technical/` or `deploy/` directory, so there is no `technical/overview.md` or `deploy/aws.md` to translate. I also did not add the short `business/README.no.md`-style stub files that exist in `freight-recovery`.

**Pattern:** each file starts with the same unofficial-translation banner as `freight-recovery`, linking to its English source. In `README.no.md` and `seo-and-growth.no.md` the banner also says that `developer-portal/` and `marketing/landing/` stay in English; in `seo-and-growth.no.md` it adds that search keywords and sample sentences are left in English.

**Caveats:** all of the English caveats are preserved:
- pre-product status, synthetic fixtures, and the DRAFT / DO-NOT-FILE outputs;
- the illustrative HTS codes, rates and FTA treatment, and the need for a licensed customs broker plus current CBP/USITC data;
- the third-party pentest requirement and statutory references flagged for counsel;
- assumptions kept labelled as ASSUMPTION, source grades A/B/C unchanged, and no new metrics.

I added two small things that were not in the English text: a note that the investor templates are deliberately kept in English, and a mention that Norwegian corporate law and tax need a licensed Norwegian advokat. The advokat mention is in `fundraising/README.no.md`, `hiring/README.no.md`, `business/business-plan.no.md`, `financial/model.no.md` and `seo-and-growth.no.md`.

**Unchanged:** code blocks, commands, API field names and the `CDR_*` / `cdk_` identifiers are kept as in the English originals. I touched nothing in `src/` or `tests/`.

Two of the files changed on disk after I pushed (`business/business-plan.no.md` and `marketing/seo-and-growth.no.md`). I did not touch them again, so those changes are not in the commit. If they were deliberate, they still need committing.
